meta.author:
讚美之泉
曲：游智婷／詞：林慶忠

lines.a: 雖然道路崎嶇 困難險阻
lines.b: Sometimes, in life, we face trials and storms

lines.a: 但我心中知道 祢一直都在
lines.b: One thing I know for sure, You're always with me

lines.a: 不能明白為何擔此重擔
lines.b: When I can barely stand, burdened with doubt

lines.a: 但我始終相信 祢一直牽著我
lines.b: I will choose to believe You're always here with me

lines.a: 大山為我挪開 大海有路出來
lines.b: Mountains move for me, oceans part for me

lines.a: 我要大聲宣告 耶穌 祢一直都在
lines.b: I'll declare it aloud, Jesus, You're always with me

lines.a: 祢手上的釘痕 彰顯十架大愛
lines.b: Nailed on the cross for me, gave Your life for me

lines.a: 我要大聲宣告 耶穌 祢一直都在
lines.b: I will shout it aloud, Jesus, You're always with me

lines.a: 祢的話讓我明白 祢愛我永不更改
lines.b: By Your words I understand, Your love never, ever fails

lines.a: 祢保守我的心懷 緊握祢雙手不放開
lines.b: Jesus, You will guard my heart, I'll hold on to You all my life

lines.a: 我要大聲宣告 耶穌 祢一直都在
lines.b: I will shout it aloud, Jesus, You're always with me
